formalProjectId.notIssuedLong: No Formal Project ID yet: AHDA issues it when it approves the registration.

register.title: Project register
register.description: Every project your role can see, at any stage.
register.emptyForRole: Your role does not give you access to any project yet.
register.emptyForRoleDescription: You see the projects your role assignments reach: those of your sector, your entity or the projects you are assigned to. When a project in that scope is registered, it appears here. If you expected to see projects, ask your administrator to check your role assignments.

mine.title: My projects
mine.description: The projects you are the Project Manager of.
mine.empty: You are not the Project Manager of any project.
mine.emptyDescription: A Project Manager is named when a registration is submitted for review. Drafts you are preparing are in the project register.

create.title: Create project
create.description: Register a new project as a draft. It gets its Formal Project ID only when AHDA approves it.

edit.title: Edit {title}
edit.notEditable: This project cannot be edited while it is {status}.

form.correctValues: To save, correct the highlighted values.
form.nonePublished: No classification is published yet. An administrator must publish one before a project can be registered.
form.governanceProfileHint: The profile sets which fields the project must have before it is submitted. AHDA confirms or changes it at review.
form.participationHint: Who delivers the project. An entity-managed project names its entity.
form.departmentHint: The AHDA department that owns the project. It sets who follows the project up.

unreadable.title: Your account cannot read some of the lists this form needs, so the project cannot be created here. Ask your administrator.
unreadable.catalogues: Classifications, governance profiles, regions and cities.

form.portfolioHint: The strategy view of the project. It does not change who may see it.
form.legacyReferenceHint: The project's number in RPMO's register, such as AHP-000001. A re-import matches on it.
form.followUpOwnerHint: The RPMO staff member who follows the project up.

workspace.tabUnavailable: This section is not available to your role for this project.

overview.missingForSubmission: Before this project can be submitted for review, fill in:
overview.declaredBaseline: Entered by legacy intake: its baseline is declared, not approved.

next.DRAFT: Draft. Complete the registration and submit it for AHDA's review.
next.SUBMITTED: Submitted. AHDA has not started its review yet; until it does, the registrant can withdraw it.
next.UNDER_REVIEW: Under AHDA's review. The registration cannot be changed until the review ends.
next.RETURNED: Returned by AHDA's review. Change the registration and submit it again as the next revision.
next.APPROVED_PLANNED: Approved and planned. AHDA activates the project when work starts.
next.SUSPENDED: Suspended. Work is on hold until an approved resumption takes effect; the Project Manager requests it from the Suspension tab, or closes the project without completion from the Closeout tab.
next.COMPLETED: Completed. Delivery has ended; Stage 2, Closure, follows once every post-project obligation is settled.
next.CLOSED: Closed. The project is terminal and read-only: its records are kept as history and nothing can be changed.

location.noMap: A map is not shown: no map service is approved for the platform yet.

reviews.caption: Review history
reviews.empty: This project has not been reviewed yet.
reviews.forbidden: Your role cannot read this project's reviews.

delete.title: Delete draft
delete.body: Delete the draft “{title}”? It is removed permanently and cannot be recovered.

submit.title: Submit for review
submit.body: Submitting sends the registration to AHDA for review and names its Project Manager. You can withdraw it until AHDA starts the review.
submit.managerHint: The Project Manager must hold the Project Manager role over this project: an AHDA employee, or a member of the delivering entity.

withdraw.label: Withdraw the submission
withdraw.consequence: The project returns to draft and its Project Manager is cleared. It can be changed and submitted again.

startReview.label: Start AHDA's review
startReview.consequence: Starts the approval route for this registration. The registrant can no longer withdraw it, and you cannot decide the review you started.

activate.label: Activate the project
activate.consequence: Makes the project Active from now. This is the only way a project becomes Active, and it cannot be reversed here.

done.submitted: The project was submitted for review.
done.withdrawn: The submission was withdrawn; the project is a draft again.

problems.referenceInvalid: One of the chosen values is no longer available: a classification, profile, region or city that is not published, an inactive sector or entity, or a city outside the chosen region. Choose again.
problems.participationInvalid: An entity-managed project must name its external entity.
problems.incomplete: The registration budget and both planned dates are needed before the project can be submitted.
problems.managerInvalid: This person cannot be the Project Manager: they must hold the Project Manager role over this project now.
problems.notEditable: The project can no longer be changed in its current state. Reload the page to see it.
problems.inUse: This draft is referenced by another record and cannot be deleted.
problems.invalidTransition: The project is no longer in a state that allows this. Reload the page to see its current state.
problems.reviewRouteMissing: No approval route is configured for project registration yet, so the review cannot start. Ask an administrator.
problems.permissionDenied: Your role does not allow this for this project.
problems.notFound: The project was not found, or you do not have access to it.

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.percentHint: 0 to 100. Leave blank when it is not available; a blank is never read as 0.
followUp.notOpen: The follow-up is kept from approval on.
followUp.complianceNoRequests: No update request is due yet
followUp.complianceCounted: {onTime} of {counted} update requests answered on time ({percent}%)
followUp.complianceOverridden: recorded by RPMO, overriding the calculation
followUp.complianceHint: Leave blank to use the calculation from the entity’s on-time answers to update requests.

followUpList.title: Follow-up list
followUpList.description: Every project in your scope that needs following up, most urgent first: stalled, suspended, late, an overdue action, then an open obstacle.
followUpList.caption: Projects that need follow-up

import.title: Import projects
import.description: Load projects from RPMO's workbook. Validate it, map the names it uses, then submit it as one batch; a second person approves the batch before its projects appear.
import.templateHint: Its lists come from the platform's master data. Required columns are marked *.
import.file: Workbook (.xlsx, up to 10 MB and 1,500 rows)
import.summary: {rows} rows: {create} to create, {update} to update, {skip} to skip; {errors} with errors, {warnings} with warnings.
import.unmatched: Names the platform does not know
import.unmatchedHint: Map each name to a value, or ask an administrator to add it. Mappings are remembered for the next import.
import.name: Project
import.notSubmittable: Fix the rows with errors and map every name before submitting.
import.rollbackConfirm: Remove the {count} projects this batch created? This is possible only while none of them has been changed.
import.approveConfirm: Apply batch {batchNo}: create {create} projects and update {update}?
import.returned: The batch was returned to its importer.
import.ownBatch: You submitted this batch, so someone else approves it.

issue.NAME_UNMATCHED: The name is not in the platform's list
issue.INITIATIVE_OUTSIDE_PORTFOLIO: The initiative is not in the chosen portfolio
issue.END_BEFORE_START: The end date is before the start date
issue.NOT_POSITIVE: The value must be more than zero
issue.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: The same reference appears twice in the file
issue.MANAGER_NOT_FOUND: The project manager has no account
issue.MANAGER_NOT_R04: The project manager does not hold the Project Manager role for this department
issue.OUTSIDE_SCOPE: The department is outside your scope
issue.STATUS_TO_CHOOSE: Choose the platform status for this word
issue.PROJECT_CLOSED: The project it matches is closed
issue.SAME_NAME_AND_ENTITY: A project with this name and entity already exists
issue.ACTIVE_PAST_END: Active, but its target end date has passed
issue.COMPLETED_BELOW_100: Completed, but actual progress is below 100%
issue.COMPLETED_FUTURE_END: Completed, but its target end date is in the future
issue.FUTURE_WITH_PROGRESS: Not started, but progress is recorded
issue.EXCEPTIONAL_VALUE: A value of SAR 10 billion or more: check it
issue.GOVERNED_FIELD_NOT_UPDATED: Differs from the project, but changes through a change request, not an import
issue.KEPT_BLANK: Left blank: shown as not available, never 0
issue.NO_CHANGE: Matches the project already: nothing to change
issue.COLUMN_IGNORED: The platform does not store this column and skips it
issue.TEMPLATE_OUTDATED: This workbook was made from an older template: download it again
issue.ENUM_VALUE: Not one of the allowed values
issue.OWNER_UNMATCHED: No active AHDA user has this name: left empty unless you map it

import.background: {rows} rows in {file}: validating in the background. You will get a notification when it is done; you may leave this page.
import.backgroundFailed: The background validation failed ({code}). Check the file and validate again.
import.backgroundDone: {file} was validated in the background. To submit it, choose the same file again.
import.askToAdd: Ask an administrator to add it to {list}
